items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Miss Ida Cox, which she was on a recording, when she came in she still had her diamonds

ctx.x: It's no way in the world that Eddie Lemons and his Dashing Dinah Revue show - these people had cars, they had 7 or 8 cars on the railroad that had their names on it. That was a big black act. Miss Ida Cox, which she was on a recording, when she came in she still had her diamonds and only had about 80 homes in Knoxville.
Hey, you and I made that record.
